sources.name: Kazakhstan EGKN PKK — Shymkent
sources.scope: Official national public cadastral map, the provider's five Shymkent district views (Abay 241, Al-Farabi 259, Enbekshi 260, Karatau 261, Turan 270; 256,205 parcels on 2026-11-27). Native cadastral numbers are supplied. Currentness, ownership and completeness are not established.
sources.attribution: Government for Citizens — EGKN public cadastral map. Shymkent; native cadastral numbers, adapted to WGS84. Ownership and currentness unestablished.
sources.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational. No named reuse licence was identified on the inspected public map.
caveats: A parcel is its kad_nomer plus its row gid (<kad_nomer>-g<gid>).

The views store 6-degree Gauss–Krüger zone 12 coordinates on GRS80 with the zone number prefixed to the easting, report EPSG:404000 and ignore srsName. Native envelopes are queried and geometry is transformed to WGS84.
The server omits its published Sectigo intermediate. Source-scoped CA supplementation preserves ordinary certificate and hostname verification.
Since 2026-11-27 the shared /geoserver/wfs address answers 403 to every client; the layer-scoped /geoserver/egkn/u_view/wfs address answers the same requests. It refuses a non-browser User-Agent.
No CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header: browsers read it through the production provider relay. A direct attempt took about 5 s to fail and pushed first loads past the 15-second deadline.
Replaces the city RGIS/AISGZK layer (geo-shym.kz), whose WFS answers "Service WFS is disabled" since 2026-11-27.
An area is read from the district views whose extent touches it; topology between neighbouring districts has not been audited.
